name: ct-release-manager
description: Release management for a commercetools catalog: an authoring console, the deploy service that ships a release to production, and two Merchant Center custom applications.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix packages/console install && npm --prefix packages/mc-releases install && npm --prefix packages/mc-branch-editor install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/console run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/mc-releases run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/mc-branch-editor run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix packages/console run lint && npm --prefix packages/mc-releases run lint && npm --prefix packages/mc-branch-editor run lint
scripts.predeploy: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
